guard: Never expose secrets or change production state, ticket state, ownership, or Git history during checkclear.

local_breadcrumb.how: Write LATEST.md and CHECKPOINT-<UTC timestamp>.md with the same standalone resume brief.

graphiti.how: Write one concise redacted episodic handoff using group_id menuwright-docs after the local breadcrumb is verified.
graphiti.readback: Search group menuwright-docs for a distinctive non-sensitive phrase from the handoff.
